{{Quote|You'll find they are totally obedient, taking any order without question. We modified their genetic structure to make them less independent|Lama Su on clones, including 4/163|<ref name="card" />}}
'''4/163''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], they participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] 4/163 was created and trained on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Enc" /> He served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="card" /> In 22 BBY,<ref name="date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was deployed in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Geonosis/Legends|same name]].<ref name="card" />

==Personality and traits==
Standing at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="Enc" /> like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="DB" /> they wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="card" /><ref name="TNEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] in combat.<ref name="card" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone trooper 4/163 was first named and depicted in the [[Star Wars Trading Card Game]] expansion [[Attack of the Clones (TCG)|Attack of the Clones]], on the Clone Warrior 4/163 card. They are depicted on Geonosis,<ref name="card" /> though no clone trooper appears in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] movie with the background as seen in the card.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
